d:
Bhartiy nyay sanhita aur usse pahle bhartiy dand sanhita men mairital rep yani vaivahik balatkar ko apvad banae jane ke khilaph sanvaidhanik yachikaon par suprim kort men sunvaee hone vali hai.
Is bich, bibisi nyuz hindi ne ek aisi mahila se bat ki hai, jisne apne pati par ek dashak tak balatkar aur hinsa karne ka aarop lagaya hai. mahila ne nyay ke lie apni laraee aur 9 sal se is mamle par chal rahi sunvaee ko lekar bat ki.
